summary: Saleor is a headless GraphQL e-commerce platform built on Django. It persists a full commerce domain: users/addresses, a product catalog (categories, product types, products, variants, channel listings, media, collections, attributes), orders and fulfillments, checkouts, payments and transactions, warehouse stock & allocations & reservations, discounts (vouchers, promotions, order/checkout discounts), gift cards, shipping zones & methods, tax classes & configurations, channels, pages, menus, staff apps & tokens, webhooks, invoices, CSV exports, and a plugin configuration registry. Mutation/action layer writes and reads all of this back via a GraphQL API.
